claim: Mastery of the entire2f decimal-representation atom is not universally necessary for the proposed bounded rounding competence. Narrow decimal place-value understanding and base-ten regrouping are necessary; they can be introduced within a small rounding lesson without assessing equivalent-fraction conversion or constructing a scaled number line.

wholePrerequisiteMeaning.description: Die lernende Person kann Dezimalzahlen auf einer passend skalierten Zahlengeraden, im Stellenwertsystem und als wertgleichen Bruch darstellen, die entsprechenden Stellen und Anteile zuordnen und begründet zwischen den Darstellungen wechseln.

assumedMinimalStartingCompetence: Recognize and order ordinary digits0–9 and follow supplied place labels.
Count a ten-part subdivision and perform one-digit successor/regrouping with a labelled table.
No whole2f, natural-rounding context-precision choice, rational-add/subtract, fraction-reduction or other-numeral-system mastery is assumed.

teachingRoute.teachingContent: Give a blank labelled table tens|ones|tenths|hundredths|thousandths|ten-thousandths. Explain adjacent columns as ten equal smaller units; a zero holds its column and ten smaller units regroup to one unit immediately left. Interpret the provided target place using these labels.
teachingRoute.boundedDelta: Only place interpretation and base-ten regrouping used by rounding; no fraction syntax, reduction, arbitrary scaled-line construction or measurement precision selection.

teachingRoute.teachingContent: Use a separate learning example2.483 to hundredths. The retained prefix2.48 identifies a hundredth step; the next digit3 identifies fewer than five of ten thousandth parts. The nearest supplied-resolution value is2.48. Explain why the later digits cannot move a3-starting discarded tail past half a hundredth.
teachingRoute.boundedDelta: Provides a reason for the decisive-digit rule without decimal subtraction; ordinary digit/order and ten-part place relationship suffice.

teachingRoute.teachingContent: Teach the supplied nearest-neighbor convention, separately stating what happens at exact ties. Explain digit increment as one step at the requested place and carry through nines as base-ten regrouping. Show truncation as removal without choosing a nearer value.
teachingRoute.boundedDelta: These are execution and meaning of the rounding operation itself. Giving the convention is task information, not giving the target answer.

teachingRoute.teachingContent: Withdraw worked answers and decision cues. Supply target place and stated rule only; a blank labelled table may remain as representation support. Require fresh place identification, independent rounded value, carry explanation where needed and comparison with truncation.
teachingRoute.boundedDelta: No highlighted decisive digit, selected neighbor, completed table or prescribed final answer. This preserves independent target performance.

counterexampleLearnerState: A consistent hypothetical learner can produce all four independent rounding explanations above, yet fail2.035→407/200 or fail to choose and draw an exact scaled interval2.03…2.04. Such failure prevents whole2f mastery while leaving the bounded rounding operation demonstrated. This is a constructive logical counterroute, not an observation of a real learner or evidence that2f has been mastered.
